pager.description: The pager command used to display textual content. Defaults to 'more' if PAGER environment variable is not set.

sacc_cert_dir.description: Directory searched for local TLS certificates when using the gophers:// scheme.

plumber.description: External program to run when opening files sacc cannot display natively.

shortcuts.description: List of keybinding objects mapping a key string to an action description or internal command.

shortcuts.items.description: Flat map of fields for a single shortcut binding entry. Note: 'type' here defines the structure of the list items, not the list itself which is 'list'. The fields below define the schema for items in the 'shortcuts' list.

shortcuts.items.key.description: The key or key sequence bound to an action.

shortcuts.items.action.description: The action performed when the key is pressed (e.g., 'Move one line down', 'Exit').
